messages:
Maya (AE): FYI ACME wants an on‑prem, air‑gapped POC. They asked about packaging (tarball vs images), upgrade cadence for air‑gapped installs, KMS/HSM support, and pricing. POC target 4–6 weeks. Can SE/eng weigh in?

Sam (SE): We can do an offline bundle + signed OCI images. Two paths: full Private (control plane in customer VPC) or inference-only appliance. For air‑gapped we deliver:
- tarball with installers
- signed OCI images they import to their registry
- offline upgrade bundles for patches

Sam (SE): For model blobs: either we include model artifacts in the bundle (good for POC) or push to their internal object store (S3-compatible). No outbound reqs for runtime.

Raj (ACME IT): Important — no outbound management plane allowed. Upgrades must be offline. Also need clar on downtime during upgrade.

Sam (SE): Upgrades: rolling upgrades for nodes, zero-downtime for inference in most configs. Control plane may need brief leader election window (~1–2 mins) during major upgrades. Patch cadence we usually do minor fixes every 4–6 weeks, major feature releases quarterly. For air‑gapped we give an offline bundle + checksum + signature.

Priya (Security): We need SBOM, signed binaries, CVE disclosure policy, and attestations for any crypto modules. Can you confirm PKCS#11/HSM support and FIPS options?

Sam (SE): Yes — we provide SBOMs and signed artifacts. For KMS: we support customer KMS via PKCS#11 or KMIP; HSM integration possible for key wrapping. FIPS builds available on request. I'll attach the security answers and the signing cert fingerprint.

Luis (Eng-Platform): We can generate offline upgrade bundles and SBOMs. For model sizes: we can include model artifacts up to ~30GB in the POC bundle; larger models we'll mirror to their internal bucket. Hardware sizing depends on model; we'll propose node counts after they share expected QPS and model family.

Maya (AE): Procurement asked if POC is free. They want a 4‑week eval and then numbers for on‑prem license + support.

Tom (Sales Ops): We typically offer a 30‑day POC waiver for platform fees; professional services/support hours billed. For production we sell term licenses + annual support. I'll draft a provisional SOW once SE confirms node counts and any onsite days.

Raj (ACME IT): Timeline: they want POC ready in ~3 weeks. Who is responsible for install in an air‑gapped environment?

Sam (SE): Joint install — SE leads remotely; if air‑gapped and they prefer, we can dispatch an engineer onsite (depends on SOW). Offline installer usually takes 1–2 days for minimal footprint. We'll need kube admin creds if they deploy to k8s, or SSH access for VM installs.

Priya (Security): Please send the security questionnaire to priya@acme.com. Also send SBOM + signed binaries and the upgrade checklist.

Sam (SE): Uploading SBOM + signed bundle to the secure share. Example import command we provide for images:
```
# on customer registry host
skopeo copy docker://registry.redwood.com/redwood/private:2025 dir:/tmp/redwood-images
# then import to internal registry
cat /tmp/redwood-images/*.tar | docker load
```

Maya (AE): @channel adding this to the deal notes and SOW draft. Will circulate the security Q + SOW. :thumbsup:

Raj (ACME IT): Ack — will coordinate with infra and confirm hardware details by EOD next Tuesday.
